source: https://www.tycho.pitt.edu/dataset/api/ (HTTP 200, 2026-08-30) — the University of Pittsburgh's own published API reference. The request examples below are transcribed from that page; the response bodies are NOT included because every Project Tycho call requires an API key and API Evangelist holds none.
authentication: apikey query parameter, obtained free from the Profile page after registering at https://www.tycho.pitt.edu

examples.name: Look up the SNOMED code for a known condition
List first-level divisions of the United States
Measles counts in Pennsylvania, excluding cumulative series and fatalities
examples.returns: CSV in Project Tycho Pre-compiled Data Format v1.0, first 5000 rows

examples.name: Page 2 of the same query
examples.returns: CSV, rows 5001-10000. An offset past the end returns the literal text "No results".

examples.name: Dengue in Laos over a date range
examples.returns: CSV. Note that the comparison operator is written into the query string itself rather than passed as a separate parameter.

examples.name: Raise the page size to the documented maximum
examples.returns: CSV, first 10000 rows. Default limit is 5000, maximum 20000.

observed_responses.name: Rejected credential
observed_responses.body: Invalid API key. Please see the API Help (https://www.tycho.pitt.edu/dataset/api) for more information.

observed_responses.name: Rejected credential on a path that does not exist
observed_responses.body: Invalid API key. Please see the API Help (https://www.tycho.pitt.edu/dataset/api) for more information.
observed_responses.note: Byte-identical to the previous response. The key is evaluated before the path is routed, so no path in this API can be confirmed to exist without a credential — which is why the OpenAPI in this repository rests on the published documentation rather than on probes.
